The platform

One integrated platform
for school leaders.

Developed and refined through collaboration with schools across St Thomas Catholic Academy Trust.

◈

School on a Page

Executive summary of school effectiveness — everything a headteacher needs in one view. Built for governors, trust boards and senior leadership.

▦

Interactive dashboards

Live data across all key performance areas with drill-down capability and trend analysis. From the overall picture to the detail in seconds.

▤

Executive summaries

High-impact reports for governors, trust boards and senior leadership teams — ready when you need them, not built the night before.

⌕

Inspection intelligence

IDSR analysis and inspection readiness support built into the platform. Walk into any inspection with your evidence base already built.

↗

Leadership evaluation

Structured self-evaluation framework aligned to Ofsted's inspection focus areas. SEF ratings sit alongside hard data for every area.

⚡

Lead portals

Each section leader completes their return via their own portal. Data flows automatically into the master dashboard — no chasing, no copying.

How it works

Set up once. Updated all year.

SOAP Analytics fits into how your school already works — not the other way around.

1

We set up your platform

Your school's details, year groups and reporting periods configured. Takes one session.

2

Leads complete their sections

Each lead — DSL, SENDCo, data manager — fills in their return via a clean, simple portal.

3

The dashboard updates

Data flows automatically into the School on a Page. No manual consolidation, no version headaches.

4

You lead with confidence

Walk into any meeting — governors, trust, Ofsted — with your school's story clear and evidenced.

About

Built by someone who's sat in your chair.

Robin Dann is the founder of SOAP Analytics and Deputy Headteacher at St Joseph's Catholic High School.

SOAP Analytics isn't built by a software company that consulted with schools. It's built by a school leader who understands the pressure of a governor meeting, the weight of an Ofsted call, and the value of having your data story straight.
